title: Lane-proportions readout can display percentages that don't sum to 100 (default balanced = 33/33/33 = 99%)
detail: Independent per-lane rounding: balanced {1,1,1} on a standard pipe (capacity 15) allocates {5,5,5}, and percent() yields 33/33/33 = 99% — the first readout the player sees. The story's readout deliverable should read as proportions of the whole.
recommended_fix: Round one lane (e.g. the last) to 100 minus the others, or display one decimal, so the readout sums to 100.
